Maximum capacity (Emax)7 kg up to and including 20 kg40 kg up to and including 80 kg

Accuracy ClassC

Ratio of minimum LC Verification interval Y = Emax / vmin600010000
Ratio of minimum dead load output return Z = Emax / (2 * DR)25004500
Input impedance415 Ω ± 15 Ω
Temperature range+10 °C / +40 °C
Fraction pLC0,7
Humidity ClassCH
